title_zh: Sport and health — 第46节可背诵讲义
body_en: You do not need to be a star to enjoy sport. Walk, move, or play ball with friends. Keep a weekly record: minutes of exercise and how you feel. If you are hurt, tell a teacher and stop. Health is progress you can check in energy, not only in scores.
body_zh: 你不必成为明星也能享受运动。散步、活动身体，或和朋友打球。做每周记录：运动分钟数和你的感觉。若受伤，告诉老师并停下。健康是你可以在精力里检查的进步，而不只是分数。
